findings: Scope: services.research_permits belongs to rules (order 9), services.registered_providers and services.charla_induccion to booking_fees (order 5) when asking entry requirements. Merge/reassign after other outputs land; do not leave duplicate intents in services.

uton_offices merges two addresses as if both official offices; the second is only supported by the concession website per log. Every numeric address/phone/hour must have official dated support; distinguish conflicting or alternate addresses rather than assert both without evidence.
potosi_cabin must distinguish the park cabin from the community-operated Refugio Potosí. Do not imply the public cabin offers lodging based only on nearby community lodging evidence.

brisas_lodging surfaces source-comparison research history in default visitor answer. Shorten to actionable confirmation before relying on accommodation; retain detailed conflict and historical report in detail/log.

charging_power default answer should say No tengo confirmado un punto de carga rather than narrate No encontré un dato oficial. Keep packing recommendation brief and avoid conflicting with preparation ownership.

cabin_status_2024 and refugio_cabin depend on historical 2024 status, and current availability is unverified. Keep date explicit and never imply service is currently operating/closed; merge historical maintenance detail into relevant cabin entry when it is not a distinct visitor intent.
charging_power example cargador is too ambiguous for a specific service; refine to a natural charging-location question.
resolved_from_existing_evidence: The saved PNN page explicitly lists BOTH UTON addresses and office hours/phones (lines 324–327 in weather_volcano evidence). Both addresses have official support; do not remove either on the basis of the initial concern.
